svg.text: Maternal mortality in Sidhi, Madhya Pradesh
April 2025 – March 2026 · 53 women died before, during or after childbirth
women dead in a single district
Sidhi's MMR — deaths per 1 lakh live births
Maternal mortality ratio — deaths per 1,00,000 live births
India's MMR fell to 87 (SRS 2022–24) — but MP is the country's 2nd-worst state, and Sidhi is far worse still.
Shyam Shah Medical College — 70 km from Sidhi
In transit — ambulances, hired vehicles, private cars
13 women died while being shifted between hospitals —
no blood, no ambulance, no specialist in time.
Leading causes — recorded in 40 of the 53 cases
Anaemia contributed to 16 deaths in all.
52.9% of pregnant women in MP are anaemic (NFHS-5).
SIDHI DISTRICT HOSPITAL — BY THE NUMBERS
blood units on the day of visit
The state's Directorate of Public Health flagged the rising toll
through letters, calls, WhatsApp messages and review meetings.
2 June 2026 — NHRC takes suo motu cognisance
Notice to the MP Chief Secretary: detailed report within two weeks.
Sidhi ranked in the bottom 3 of the state's Community Maternal
Health League — the crisis was measured, and still ignored.
1. The Indian Express — “Overwhelmed, understaffed delivery wards, 53 deaths in a year” (29 May 2026)
2. The Indian Express — “NHRC takes cognisance of Express report…” (4 Jun 2026)
3. NHRC press note — suo motu cognisance, Sidhi maternal deaths (2 Jun 2026)
